We are AIUB XENOBLADE, a team from the American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB), Dhaka, Bangladesh 

🌎 Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map

Our project aims to make Martian accessible through an immersive 3D Mars globe, terrain   and a Mission Lab by NASA-related datasets.

By transforming planetary data into an interactive exploration experience, we aim to help students, researchers, space enthusiasts, and future explorers better understand the Martian environment.
